title: A capillary threshold is not a validated digital state
statement: Introduced100um side neck has5000Pa threshold; .12uL stroke requires .152789mm diaphragm motion. Single20uL sealed gas at40C gives6274.48Pa at zero stroke and7889.56Pa at full stroke with gravity, above the modeled threshold. Larger fixed volume does not cancel zero-stroke thermal pressure. Perfect temperature-compensating volume would need1.67701uL per cell from15to40C and is unbuilt. A .25s forward/return cycle costs1.208381554uJ modeled head work, not total machine energy or a positive pulling attachment.

assumptions: Circuit linearity and no extra conducting paths are hypotheses. Thermal cancellation at zero displacement does not cancel differential temperatures, fill/volume errors, gas loss or nonzero-displacement spring force. Thermal bridges carry their particular electrical topology and capacitance.
